mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_score(trade_date, model_version, score, state, evidence_json, is_synthetic) VALUES(#{tradeDate}, #{modelVersion}, #{score}, #{state}, #{evidenceJson}, #{synthetic}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_json= VALUES(evidence_json), score= VALUES(score), state= VALUES(state)
mapper.select: SELECT id, trade_date, model_version, score, state, evidence_json, created_at, updated_at, is_synthetic FROM market_score WHERE model_version IN ('MARKET_V2','MARKET_V3') AND model_version=(SELECT MAX(n.model_version) FROM market_score n WHERE n.trade_date=market_score.trade_date AND n.is_synthetic=market_score.is_synthetic AND n.model_version IN ('MARKET_V2','MARKET_V3')) AND is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND trade_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY trade_date
